seed.description: Seed of every random fault draw, so a faulty run repeats. Each subject draws from its own stream derived from the seed and the subject.

subjects.description: Faults injected into the messages a process receives, one entry per NATS subject (pkg/transport/nats Faults). Empty injects nothing. Read by every Go node that loads this file; for tests and simulation, never for a race.

subject.description: Exact NATS subject the faults apply to; wildcards are rejected.

delay_ms.description: Fixed delay in milliseconds before a received message is handed to the reader.

jitter_ms.description: Maximum extra delay in milliseconds, drawn uniformly per message; order is kept.

drop_rate.description: Long-run fraction of messages lost, in bursts (Gilbert-Elliott); 0 disables loss.

drop_burst.description: Mean number of consecutive messages lost once a loss starts; 1 gives independent losses.

freeze_rate_hz.description: Average number of freezes starting per second (Poisson); while frozen every message is replaced by the last one let through, as a stuck driver republishing its last reading. 0 disables freezes.

freeze_ms.description: How long each freeze lasts, in milliseconds.

reorder_rate.description: Probability that a message is held back and delivered right after the next one.

noise_sigma.description: Standard deviation of zero-mean Gaussian noise added to float and double fields, in each field's own units.

noise_fields.description: Names of the fields noise_sigma applies to, at any depth; empty applies it to every float and double field.
